chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The first reward the forbearing person gets for his forbearance is that people become his helpers against the ignorant.

key_terms.الْجَاهِل: The ignorant, one lacking knowledge or wisdom

ai.seo_question: What is the first reward of forbearance according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the social utility of hilm (forbearance), noting that it transforms potential adversaries into allies who support the patient individual against the rash. This reflects the Shia understanding of hilm not merely as passive restraint, but as a strategic virtue that commands respect and facilitates justice in communal interactions. The concept underscores how self-control serves as a shield against the chaos of ignorance (jahil), aligning with the broader Islamic ethic of wisdom in social conduct.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 206. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The first reward the exerciser of forbearance gets is that people become his helpers against the ignorant.
